'''Anyad''' is a NPC female student who was suppose to graduate but was held back after accidentally revealing she had the potentials of becoming a [[Startorch_Academy#Rabelle_College|Syncronist]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Mirek:''' Wow, Anya... wow. You were supposed to be defending your thesis and graduating in the New Federation!
:'''Anyad:''' Waaah! I just went with a friend to that selection project Academic Development was hosting... and I accidentally touched some weird Rabelle's Curve measuring device, that's all!
:'''Anyad:''' Then those people from the Academic Committee wouldn't let me leave. Said I was a potential Synchronist, and that my curve was compatible with the [[Exostrider]]'s...
:'''Anyad:''' I worked so hard... I was this close... and now I have to start all over again from scratch here...
:'''Anyad:''' WAHHHHHHH—!
:'''Nanelle:''' Think of it as just a postponed graduation. Be strong, okay?
:'''Anyad:''' A postponed graduation? That's the worst part! WAHHHHH—!
----
;After completing {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:'''Mirek:''' Anya, I heard they're closing down Rabelle College... If you go back to the New Federation now, will your credits transfer over?
:'''Anyad:''' No. I enrolled here, and this college answers directly to the Spacetrek Collective. Without a formal graduation, I'm not sure it'll work.
:'''Mirek:''' Then what are you going to do now?
:'''Anyad:''' It's fine. I'm perfectly calm. At any rate... At any rate, Aleph-1 is gone now. All I need to do is stay calm and find a time machine...
:'''Mirek:''' Stop! You are NOT finding a TIME MACHINE in a TRASH CAN! At least consider a phone booth!
{{Dialogue End}}
